name: @wise-evidence/ai
description: Provider-independent AI subsystem for WiseEvidence (Milestone 6): AIProvider interface, deterministic offline MockAIProvider, an OpenAI-compatible provider (injected fetch), a versioned prompt registry, the six enrichment tasks with structured-output validation, SHA-256 input hashing, deterministic cache identity, and cost derivation. AI is a suggestion engine, never an authority. No Astro, React, Supabase, or provider SDK imports; no database imports.
